sentences.text: The allegations made in this writ petition are basically two fold.
sentences._hearing_file: Assam vs The State Of Assam And 5 Ors on 2 September, 2022.json

sentences.text: Firstly, that no valid reason has been cited for rejecting the technical bid submitted by the petitioner.
sentences._hearing_file: Assam vs The State Of Assam And 5 Ors on 2 September, 2022.json

sentences.text: Secondly, the respondent no. 5 has submitted self certified statement of experience but not from the competent authority whereas, the respondent no. 6 has not submitted the said documents at all.
sentences._hearing_file: Assam vs The State Of Assam And 5 Ors on 2 September, 2022.json

sentences.text: Mr. Banik submits that the bids of the respondent nos. 5 and 6 were also liable to be rejected on technical grounds.
sentences._hearing_file: Assam vs The State Of Assam And 5 Ors on 2 September, 2022.json

sentences.text:
Since the petitioner's counsel has prayed for an interim order, I deem it appropriate to direct Mr. B.
Deuri, the learned Government Advocate, Assam, to obtain instruction responding to the allegations made by the petitioner.
sentences._hearing_file: Assam vs The State Of Assam And 5 Ors on 2 September, 2022.json

sentences.text: Let this writ petition be listed for motion again on 09/09/2022.
sentences._hearing_file: Assam vs The State Of Assam And 5 Ors on 2 September, 2022.json

sentences.text: Two extra copies of the writ petition be furnished to Mr. Deuri during the course of the day.

opennyai_summary.final__facts: The affidavit of service filed by the petitioner indicates that though the respondent No. 6 has been given Dasti Service of the notice, the respondent No. 5, which is represented by Vivek Agarwal has not received the Dasti Service of the notice.
opennyai_summary.final__decision:
In view of the above, though the notice can be said to be served upon the respondent No. 6, it cannot be said to be served upon the respondent No. 5.
Petitioner is given liberty to serve notice on the respondent No. 5 by Dasti Service afresh within 2 weeks.
List the matter after 2 (two) weeks.
Interim order passed earlier to continue till the next date.
